Pawan Negi appointed interim selector; BCCI seeks new chief selector

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is seeking a new chief selector for the men's selection committee. Parthiv Patel reportedly did not apply for the position. With Patel out of contention, Pragyan Ojha is considered a strong candidate to become the chief selector. Pawan Negi has been appointed as an interim selector.
